description: Retrieve all submissions made by one specific student (or group) in a dropbox folder, for an instructor or TA — useful for reviewing a single student's work before drafting feedback. Use get_dropbox_submissions or get_roster to find the userId first. Requires instructor or TA access to the course.

courseId.description: Course ID the dropbox folder belongs to.

ignoreFeedback.description: When true, omit feedback status from the response.

userId.description: Brightspace user ID (or group ID for a group folder) whose submissions to retrieve.

name: get_dropbox_user_submissions
title: Get Dropbox User Submissions
